headline: President Bush made further changes to an earlier order that set up the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13285, which created the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation. That council works on encouraging and honoring volunteer service. No summary was provided, so the specific changes this order makes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation
who_it_affects.how: The rules governing the council they serve on were changed, though the details are not given in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Most likely on signing, August 28, 2008, though the source does not say.
